board.note: First board — and it was built twice, because the collection was stripped back to the Goodreads shelf mid-assembly and the philosophy seam it was aimed around is gone. What is left has no economics, no Dane, and nothing on capital or research policy, so these nine come through four doors it does not have; all nine were read in a primary source rather than recalled.

proposals.text: Of all ridiculous things the most ridiculous seems to me, to be busy—to be a man who is brisk about his food and his work.

verification.note: Read in L. M. Hollander’s translation, "Selections from the Writings of Kierkegaard" (University of Texas Bulletin No. 2326, 1923), which prints the Diapsalmata that open Either/Or.
